_about: Gold query set for the 10-book indexed corpus. 100 entries = 50 scenes x 2 variants. Each scene was picked from the corpus and gives its id as target_scene_id (the guaranteed rank-1 answer). For every scene there are TWO queries with the SAME frame/svos/descriptors/target but different summaries: variant 'specific' (a clear, detailed summary) and variant 'ambiguous' (a much vaguer, generalized summary that still resolves to that single scene). Comparing the two tests the model's ability to generalize from a loose description. 5 scenes per book, sharpness 1 (very unique) -> 5 (generic archetype).
